reason: Free costs me nothing, but my time and a production app don't. I'd star it on GitHub and wait, I'm not pointing an AI that 'explores on its own' at a city system based on a landing page.
objection: It's a student project with AI writing the business rules. If it misses a rule, I get a false 'nothing changed' and that's worse than no tool. And who maintains it next year when our migration is still running?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it catch a real regression on an old Windows app like ours, run fully offline, plus a year of steady commits and issues getting answered.
